verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a built-in AI assistant inside Google Cloud that users can delegate tasks to. Vertex AI is a platform for developers to build their own agents, which is a developer building block. The Cloud Run MCP server and MCP Toolbox let external agents connect to Google Cloud resources, which is an adjacent capability rather than an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
